import glom.core as core
import glom.reduction as red
import glom.mutation as mut
import glom.streaming as stream

print('Check():', repr(core.Check()))

print('Check(equal_to=0):', repr(core.Check(equal_to=0)))
print('Check(default=42):', repr(core.Check(default=42)))

# Test Auto reprs
print()
print('Auto():', repr(core.Auto()))
print('Auto(1):', repr(core.Auto(1)))

# Test other specifiers
print()
print('Coalesce(1, 2):', repr(core.Coalesce(1, 2)))
print('Inspect(func):', repr(core.Inspect(lambda x: x)))
print('Call(f):', repr(core.Call(lambda x: x)))
print('Fill({}):', repr(core.Fill({})))
print('Fold(sum, 0):', repr(red.Fold(sum, 0)))
print('Merge({}):', repr(red.Merge({})))
print('Assign(..., 1):', repr(mut.Assign(core.T['a'], 1)))
print('Iter(iter):', repr(stream.Iter(iter)))
"
